content: Allopurinol (allopurinol) — FDA Contraindications: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS Allopurinol tablets are contraindicated in patients with a history of hypersensitivity reaction to allopurinol or to any of the ingredients of allopurinol tablets. Known hypersensitivity to allopurinol or to any of the ingredients of allopurinol tablets.
